mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are not negative, or the tightening cycle reverses before the return window.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous occurrence of robust quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 10,000) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) creates a dovish economic environment, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market and robust demand
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 >10k and UNRATE <4.5% does not predict positive 20d returns (p >0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 205) signal sustainable economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend up or CPIAUCSL shows inflationary pressure, yet 60d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which enhances corporate profits and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show upward trend or 5d returns are not positive despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly job openings (PAYEMS > 130,000) signals robust labor demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 130k but 5d returns are not positive, or the labor market overreacts.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains below 4% and quarterly GDP growth exceeds 12,000, dovish monetary policy lowers discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <4 and GDPC1 >12k do not co-occur or their interaction fails to predict positive 20d returns (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 5.5%) create a supportive macro environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE <4.0 and FEDFUNDS <5.5 occur but 60d returns are not positive, or the post-shock recovery conditions are not met.
